Oh.  Never heard of it.  Wonder if they intentionally rigged their acronym to farm Google searches or the like....

On a vaguely related topic, someone showed off a new deckbuilding Kickstarter game the other night, and I didn't quite catch the name (I want to say it was Heroes of Metro City or something close to that).  Sounded interesting, but the game had no art so I couldn't quite bring myself to care...but the concept was supposed to be that, instead of building a deck of full of existing superheroes, you build a deck which represents a single original superhero, and I found that concept quite appealing.

posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Heh, no, we just came up with a name we really liked, used it a bunch, and then wrote down the acronym and went, "Oh. Hell."

But by that time we were already very attached to the name. It fits. It's good. And it's not like we use the acronym of the name of expansion in an official in game or business way. 

No underhanded intent here!

At least, not with the name of that expansion...
